detail.longDescription:
Create eye-catching videos in seconds with AI Video Generator. Turn your ideas, text, and photos into dynamic AI-generated videos with just a few taps.
Upload a photo, enter your idea, or choose a style and let AI transform your content into a ready-to-share video. From text to video or photo to video, AI Video Generator makes video creation simple and accessible.

Whether you want to create social media content, creative videos, short-form clips, or visual stories, AI Video gives you intuitive tools to bring your ideas to life.

【 Create Videos with AI 】

Explore different ways to create with an AI video generator:

▶ Turn your ideas and prompts into videos with AI text to video
▶ Transform photos into dynamic clips with AI photo to video
▶ Bring images to life with AI image to video
▶ Explore creative video styles and AI-powered effects
▶ Create short-form videos for social media
▶ Experiment with different concepts, scenes, and visual styles
▶ Generate videos directly from your mobile device
▶ Save and share your creations easily
From simple ideas to creative visual concepts, AI Video Generator helps you create unique videos without complicated editing tools.

【 Text to Video 】
Describe what you want to see and turn your words into AI-generated video.
Enter your idea, choose your preferred options, and generate a video based on your prompt. Experiment with different concepts and discover new ways to turn imagination into motion.

【 Photo to Video 】
Bring your favorite images to life.
Upload a photo and use AI photo to video tools to transform static images into animated videos. Explore different styles and effects to create engaging results from your photos.

【 Creative AI Video Styles 】
Discover new ways to transform your content with a variety of AI-powered video styles and effects.

【 Simple Video Creation 】
No advanced editing experience required.

Create an AI video in a few simple steps:
Enter an idea or upload a photo
Choose an available style or effect
Generate your AI video
Save or share your creation
The simple creation flow makes it easy to experiment with different ideas and generate videos directly from your phone.

You can use AI Video Generator for:
• Short-form content
• Social media videos
• Creative video concepts
• Photo animations
• Visual storytelling
• Marketing content
• Educational content
• Personal projects
• AI-generated video experiments
Whether you're exploring a new creative idea or producing content for your audience, AI Video Generator gives you an easy way to turn ideas and images into videos.

【 Create Your Next AI Video 】
Turn text into video. Animate your photos. Explore creative styles and discover new ways to create with AI.

Subscriptions are offered as auto-renewable plans on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis (pricing may vary by country). Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your Apple Account Settings after purchase. If a free trial is offered, any unused portion of the trial period will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.
